title: EXX layer shows small-range bumps or non-smooth segments
symptom: Localized EXX bumps over a narrow k/band region while the rest of the bands is smooth.

candidate_experiments.expected_improvement: keeps more shrunk auxiliary functions and reduces the EXX LRI error
candidate_experiments.guard: watch for linear dependence; verify the Coulomb spectrum and retained rank before accepting

stop_condition: EXX bands are smooth or the shrunk basis becomes ill-conditioned (go to r9).
